The guard's torch hit the pillow.
The head on it was fake.
Three men were gone from Alcatraz.
If the guards found the holes, it was over.
They dug out the air vents in their cells with homemade tools.
They turned prison raincoats into a raft.
On the night of June eleventh, they climbed up to the roof.
Then they climbed down and pushed off into the dark bay.
At sunrise, the guards found out.
The three men were never seen again.
Nobody knows if they made it.
Somewhere, three fake heads are still asleep.
